### Above All, Pray
Author: Pastor Jeff Schreve
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/fromhisheart/from-his-heart-week-of-april-11.html
Passage: Luke 18:1
Points:
- Many believers experience a prayer life that feels dry, distracted, or discouraged when answers do not come quickly.
- Spiritual warfare targets prayer because it links our weakness to God's almighty power.
- Jesus consistently demonstrated the priority of prayer, showing that believers need it even more.
- In Jesus' parable, a powerless widow received justice from an uncaring judge simply through persistent asking.
- If even an unjust judge responds to persistence, our righteous heavenly Father will surely answer His children who do not give up.
